artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic NumPy verification of the sharp endpoint construction, the threshold, and the global and history-aware residual bounds on SPD examples.
Deterministic output of the numerical verification.

limitations: Exact arithmetic and finite-dimensional real SPD matrices only. The PCG extension is in the natural preconditioned residual norm. Current published work covers the central sharp all-step factor, universal threshold, and fixed-preconditioner consequence; the residual history refinement is not enough to preserve originality of the unchanged finding.
provenance: Scientific sources, proof evidence, and the fresh independent assessment are documented in the research and dated audit files.
record_title: Sharp condition-number threshold for monotone exact-CG residuals
